principle: Patterns may orchestrate components, but structural surface/layout ownership must resolve through primitives/foundations before React implementation.

governedUnusedPrimitiveArtifacts.name: Illustration Assets
governedUnusedPrimitiveArtifacts.reason: Illustration Assets governs approved image sources; current formal patterns do not render illustration slots directly.
governedUnusedPrimitiveArtifacts.migrationAction: Keep as asset primitive; add direct pattern declaration only when an onboarding/empty/hero pattern owns illustration slots.

governedUnusedPrimitiveArtifacts.name: Library Sources
governedUnusedPrimitiveArtifacts.reason: Library Sources governs vendor/runtime intake for other primitives; direct pattern usage would be expected only for a source-management workflow.
governedUnusedPrimitiveArtifacts.migrationAction: Keep as primitive governance; require consuming primitives to declare it before introducing vendors.
